commit_note: The integer FR-015 left blank. Written from the measured census at the exit, not chosen: region_charge_gate reported 7 of 16 CHARGED. From here the gate asserts charged_count >= 7 on every run, so the count may rise and may never fall.

identity_gap.why_this_block_exists: FR-015 pins the floor's IDENTITY, not only its integer. Recording 7 without this block would let a count stand in for the thing the count is about, which is the failure this gate was built to prevent. Insula is the only region in the tree that is CHARGED-BUT-UNREACHABLE: its two body_in edges already carry diverged measured attributions, so the gap is one static live-path import, not a missing measurement. It is scoped in specs/022-unified-brain-arc/evidence/s0-exit.md and was deliberately NOT force-wired.
